g.text: Per column: contact -> 4.99k -> quad protected S/D -> protected node -> S2; S1 grounds RHD until ACQUIRE is admitted.

g.desc: Per column: contact -> 4.99k -> quad protected S/D -> protected node -> S2; S1 grounds RHD until ACQUIRE is admitted.

g.text: DIGITAL RESEARCH CIRCUIT / ARTIFICIAL SIGNALS / NO PCB OR IMPLANT QUALIFICATION

g.desc: DIGITAL RESEARCH CIRCUIT / ARTIFICIAL SIGNALS / NO PCB OR IMPLANT QUALIFICATION

g.text: Spinal concept: 16 positive contacts + 1 shared reference + separate passive bias; amplifier linearity and biological recording remain conditional.

g.desc: Spinal concept: 16 positive contacts + 1 shared reference + separate passive bias; amplifier linearity and biological recording remain conditional.

g.text: 470pF is at the RHD pin; 10M bleeds the internal node. Switch capacitance/leakage/injection and shared reference mismatch remain modeled assumptions.

g.desc: 470pF is at the RHD pin; 10M bleeds the internal node. Switch capacitance/leakage/injection and shared reference mismatch remain modeled assumptions.

g.text: Fault threshold follows +/-5V rails and is far outside RHD +/-0.4V linear DC range. External low-voltage qualification is mandatory before unclamping.

g.desc: Fault threshold follows +/-5V rails and is far outside RHD +/-0.4V linear DC range. External low-voltage qualification is mandatory before unclamping.
